files.content: import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, computed, inject, input, } from "@angular/core" import { DomSanitizer, type SafeHtml } from "@angular/platform-browser" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { spinnerVariants, type SpinnerColor, type SpinnerSize, } from "./spinner.variants" // Raw SVG from @material-symbols/svg-400 (progress_activity, Rounded) — // single swap point for the spinner glyph. const SPINNER_SVG = `` /** * Angular port of @force-ui/spinner (radix-force-ui style). * * Usage: * * * * * aria-hidden="true" — the spinner is purely visual. The container owns the * semantic loading state via aria-busy="true" + an aria-live region. * See DIVERGENCES.md §spinner-5. * * animate-spinner requires --animate-spinner: spin 500ms linear infinite in * the consuming app's tailwind.css. See DIVERGENCES.md §spinner-2. */ @Component({ selector: "[uiSpinner]", standalone: true, templateUrl: "./spinner.component.html", changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush, host: { "data-slot": "spinner", "aria-hidden": "true", "[attr.data-color]": "color()", "[attr.data-size]": "size()", "[class]": "classes()", }, }) export class SpinnerComponent { readonly color = input("default") readonly size = input("sm") readonly className = input(undefined, { alias: "class" }) protected readonly icon: SafeHtml = inject(DomSanitizer).bypassSecurityTrustHtml(SPINNER_SVG) protected readonly classes = computed(() => cn( spinnerVariants({ color: this.color(), size: this.size() }), this.className() ) ) }

export { SpinnerComponent as Spinner } from "./spinner.component"
export {
  spinnerVariants,
  type SpinnerVariants,
  type SpinnerColor,
  type SpinnerSize,
} from "./spinner.variants"
